tier_up_1.say: Any unit near {street}, {cause}. One car respond.
Report of {cause} on {street}. Nearest unit take it.

tier_up_2.say: Second car rolling. Stingers authorised on {street}.
Upgrading to two units. Strip them if they run.

tier_up_3.say: All units, felony pursuit. Air One up, block the road ahead.
Priority, all units. Air support and a roadblock, {street}.

lost.say: Lost visual near {street}. Searching the area.

spikes_down.say: Strip's down ahead of them on {street}.

spikes_hit.say: Tyres are gone! They're on the rims.
They hit the strip. Won't get far on that.

roadblock_up.say: Roadblock's up on {street}. Two cars across it.
We're across {street}, lights on, strip in the gap.

heli_on_night.say: Air One on scene. Light's on.

tier_down_2.say: Air One released, block's down. Two cars stay on {street}.

tier_down_1.say: Scaling back. One unit keep looking near {street}.

clear.say: Suspect's gone. All units, code 4, resume patrol.
Nothing. Stand down, back to patrol.
